title: Open Problems on Billiards and Geometric Optics
exact_target: Does the existence of two nested caustics, with the inner also a caustic inside the outer, force the original smooth convex table to be an ellipse?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 5200007 (AMR-051-0007). CC BY 4.0.

M. Bialy, C. Fierobe, A. Glutsyuk, M. Levi, A. Plakhov and S. Tabachnikov, \emph{Open problems on billiards and geometric optics} (2021), arXiv:2110.10750v2, Alexey Glutsyuk, Problem 1 (question of Konstantin Khanin, August 2019), pp. 5--6.
